question: The IPCC is the United Nations body for assessing the science related to climate change. IPCC stands for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IPCC's** full form is **Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change**
 
• It is an **international organization** that **assesses the reasons behind climate change**.
 
• It is a **part of the United Nations.**
 
• It was **established** by the **World Meteorological Organization **(WMO) and the **United Nations Environment Programme** (UNEP).
 
• Its **objective** is to **provide input to all governments** regarding the **scientific information** and **Technical Guidance **that may be **used to design climate policies.**
 
• It **releases annual assessment reports** that guide the governmental decision-making process and and plays an important role in UNFCCC-COP meetings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IPCC**

 
 
• Established: **1988**
 
• Headquarters: **Geneva**, Switzerland
 
• It was awarded the Nobel peace prize in 2007 for its role in assessing man-made climate change.
 
• **Rajendra Pachauri** served as chairman of IPCC.
